claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Fluconazole is expected to be largely inactive against human cancer cell lines at 2.5 uM, since its target CYP51A1 is a fungal sterol demethylase and human cells lack a sensitive ortholog; any weak antiproliferative effect would reflect nonspecific azole off-target activity rather than a shared cytotoxic mechanism.
